question: Does the negative time-stratified posttrain-minus-pre minus catch direction observed in development persist in the first available sessions of other task animals?
selection: Exclude ICMS93 entirely from external animal set. Earliest dated behavior+ecephys file for every other subject, chosen from frozen85-asset manifest before reading response payload. No replacement for unsupported sessions. Acquisition order ascending file size only.
analysis: All provided units; good-trial primary and all-quality sensitivity. Pre[-.7,-.2), post[.8,1.3) relative to train start, catch relative to trial start. Require nominal100Hz70pulse700ms trains; otherwise flag contract mismatch. Four equal ordinal blocks of all session trials; compare per-unit mean paired change with same-block catch, weight by stimulated trial count. Report all nonzero currents separately, no pooling animals or units for p-values.
gate: For each observed current, require at least one eligible catch in every occupied block and pre/post windows inside wheel-duration proxy with no electrical-train overlap. Missing support remains undefined, do not discard unsupported blocks to obtain a primary estimate. Preserve all failure counts. Flag trial loss; no automatic claim of full population coverage.
directional_rule: Descriptive transfer only: all defined primary current means strictly negative in all5 animals supports this narrow direction; any zero/positive is a directional counterexample; any undefined animal/current prevents full scope confirmation. This is not a calibrated hypothesis test or L2-L4 evidence.
limitations: Previously published data; independence is from local ICMS93 development, not unseen literature. First-session selection limits training stage. Movement, processing and coarse within-block drift remain. No same-cell anatomy join or causal mediation.
